surprises: IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W172-S1: the Orion silver fact_transactions and fact_performance partitions are cumulative, so a per-date read double-counts history (OBSERVATION, ARMED, disarm owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~D2).
IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W172-S2: the ratified taxonomy classes reinvested income as Internal, so the WITHOUT-income figure keeps reinvested income (OBSERVATION, INERT).
IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W172-S3: the performance table is client-level and the client holds two accounts, so the reported figure is not account-level (OBSERVATION, ARMED, disarm owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~D2).
